word_bank.example: My mother makes the best soup.
My father reads the newspaper every morning.
My sister is two years younger than me.
My brother lives in Tel Aviv.
My grandmother bakes cookies every Friday.
Their son is starting school this year.
His daughter loves to draw and paint.
My cousin comes to visit every summer.
My uncle is a doctor in Haifa.

stage_2_story.text_en: Last Saturday, David brought his family to his parents' house for lunch. His mother cooked a big meal, and his father set the table outside in the garden. David's sister came with her husband, and his brother drove in from the north. Their grandfather sat in his favourite chair and told stories about the old country, while their grandmother handed out slices of cake she had baked the night before. David's son and daughter played with their cousin in the backyard. Even David's uncle, who rarely leaves his farm, made the trip. Everyone sat together, laughed, and ate until the sun went down. David looked around the table and felt lucky to have such a close family.
